name: iUnion_Ioo_of_tendsto
statement: Box ι} {J : ℕ → Box ι} (hJ : Monotone J) (hl : Tendsto (lower ∘ J) atTop (𝓝 I.lower)) (hu : Tendsto (upper ∘ J) atTop (𝓝 I.upper)) : ⋃ n, Box.Ioo (J n) = Box.Ioo I

have_tree.name: hl'
have_tree.type: ∀ i, Antitone fun n ↦ (J n).lower i

have_tree.name: hu'
have_tree.type: ∀ i, Monotone fun n ↦ (J n).upper i

name: distortion_eq_of_sub_eq_div
statement: Box ι} {r : ℝ} (h : ∀ i, I.upper i - I.lower i = (J.upper i - J.lower i) / r) : distortion I = distortion J

name: dist_le_distortion_mul
statement: Box ι) (i : ι) : dist I.lower I.upper ≤ I.distortion * (I.upper i - I.lower i)
